outcome: total retina nasal outer sector thickness
cohort: The study included 51 children (19 full-term and 32 preterm) without retinopathy of prematurity, with mean ages at examination of 10.58 and 14.13 years respectively.
finding: Preterm children without ROP exhibit significantly decreased retinal thickness, particularly in the ganglion cell layer and inner plexiform layer in the outer macular areas, compared to full-term children.
cross-section timing: Ophthalmic examination performed at a mean age of 10.58 years for full-term children and 14.13 years for preterm children.
